text:
Zoe (PM): kicking off a compact rollout plan for 'slimline-canary' (feature: latency-aware routing + model v4). main ask: conservative tenant opt-in alpha, EU shadowing, automated decay on anomalies.
Kai (Eng): high-level approach: flag + A/B + adaptive-split. Start with shadowing in EU (10% shadow) for 36h, then NA opt-in visible 3% -> 15% -> 60%. adaptive-split rule: if p99 rises by >20% within a 10min window, the system decays variant ratio by half automatically.
Hana (SRE): canary infra thoughts: reserve two warm r5/gpu-like nodes in eu-west and us-east. We'll pre-warm KV caches and model weights. Alarms to wire: sustained p99>320ms OR error_rate(5xx)>0.45% for 6m -> trigger auto-decay then if unresolved after 5m trigger full rollback to baseline. Add per-tenant blackout windows so enterprise tenants with scheduled maintenance are never assigned visible variants.
Rory (Data): telemetry checklist: per-tenant p50/p95/p99, 5xx% by region, token-cost delta, quality lift on seeded eval set, and per-cohort sample counts. I'll produce a 2k human-labeled spot-check bundle for quick manual checks and a 12k automated sample for A/B stats.
Zoe (PM): launch gates: smoke at 3% (no infra alarms, quality delta <=1.2% on seeded eval, no manual red flags), automated increase to 15% if rolling 12h steady; manual review before 60% ramp. Require runbook with explicit roll-forward and roll-back criteria + customer comms draft.
Kai (Eng): flag prototype for ops repo (paste-ready):
```json
{"flag":"slimline_canary_v1","mode":"opt_in","variants":[{"name":"baseline","ratio":0.97},{"name":"v4","ratio":0.03}],"shadow":{"region":"EU","ratio":0.10},"auto_decay":{"on_metric":"p99","threshold_pct":20,"decay_factor":0.5},"kill_switch":"global_off","tenant_blackout_field":"blackout_windows"}
```
Hana (SRE): fallback sequence: first auto-decay (reduce traffic to v4 by factor), then try quantized-gpu fallback for 2m, then baseline. We'll implement an automated notification to #eng-oncall and create an incident marker if rollback occurs. Also add rate-limiter per-tenant to avoid noisy neighbor effects.
ops-bot: scheduled shadow_start: 2026-06-20T04:00Z, visible_na_start: 2026-06-22T16:00Z, soft-window: 2026-06-22T16:00Z-2026-06-22T17:00Z
Rory (Data): required sample sizes: 12k per-arm for 1.2% detectable delta at 95% power; for quick smoke we'll use the 2k human-labeled set to validate obvious regressions. I'll put dashboard panels: lift, p-values, cohort counts, rolling p99.
Zoe (PM): enterprise asks: Customer Z wants EU-only opt-out and audit trail for any per-tenant overrides. Also they requested a stamped pre-approval step before any visible assignment.
Hana (SRE): we'll add per-tenant metadata fields: "region_only":true and "pre_approved":true checked by the rollout system. Also wire audit logs to include the pre-approval id and KMS key reference for compliance.
Kai (Eng): infra tasks: implement flag schema and checker for tenant meta, add adaptive-split controller, implement shadow routing and quantized fallback path.
Hana (SRE): SRE tasks: reserve canary nodes, alarm rules, per-tenant blackout enforcement, and schedule a 20m pre-canary ops review.
Rory (Data): data tasks: eval harness, dashboard PR, and sampling queries. I'll also implement a quick-diff job that computes rolling A/B lift every 15m and posts to the dashboard.
Zoe (PM): comms/runbook tasks: I'll draft the tenant-facing notes, rollback FAQ, and on-call escalation steps. Target soft launch window: week of 2026-06-22.
Kai (Eng): one engineering note: we should add a synthetic holdback cohort (1% global) permanently for regression detection across releases.
Rory (Data): good idea. that'll help detect drift. I'll add "holdback_1pct" as a persistent cohort in dashboards.
Zoe (PM): blockers? :eyes:
Kai (Eng): need CI job green for the adaptive-split controller by 2026-06-18.
Hana (SRE): I'll block if canary nodes not reserved or if blackout enforcement code isn't in place.
Rory (Data): dashboards ETA: 2026-06-18 EOD.
Zoe (PM): thanks team 44d i'll post the final runbook in #launchroom after infra PRs merge and ping owners.
